episode_results.instruction: Take the glossy black mug medium-sized for drinking, rotate it, place it in the center, then hang it on the angular rack with slanted support rod.
Pick the blue mug with solid texture, turn it, put it in the center, and transfer it to the dark gray angled rack.
Lift the medium mug fits in hand from the table, turn it, put it down in the middle, then hang it onto the angled rack with long and short rods.
Take the white ceramic mug with handle from the table, spin it, place it in the center, then hang it on the angular rack with slanted support rod.
Take the mug with cartoon design with one arm, rotate it, and hang it onto the metallic angular rack with rod pair.
Pick up the beige mug polished ceramic build, turn it, place it centrally, then hang the beige mug polished ceramic build onto the metal rack.
Use your left arm to grab the brown mug for drinking, rotate it, set it down, then hang on the medium rack with protruding rods.
Use the left arm to grab the palm-sized mug glossy black body, rotate it, place it down, and hang it onto the angled rack with long and short rods with the right arm.
With the left arm, grab the mug with blue print, spin it, place it down, then use the right arm to hang it on the metal rack.
Grab the ceramic mug with printed logo, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it on the smooth rack.
With the left arm, grab the black ceramic mug, spin it, place it down, then use the right arm to hang it on the smooth dark gray rack.
Take the mug with side handle, rotate it, set it in the middle, then hang it on the rack with two rods sticking out.
Use the right arm to lift the mug with rounded handle, rotate it, and attach it to the smooth dark gray rack after setting it down.
Using your left arm, lift the ceramic mug with printed logo, rotate it, place it down, then your right arm to hang it onto the medium rack with protruding rods.
Pick the colorful cartoon mug from the table using one hand, rotate, and hang it on the metallic angular rack with rod pair.
Use the right arm to lift the black mug with handle, rotate it, and attach it to the metallic rack with smooth finish after setting it down.
Use the left arm to grab the handle-mounted blue drinking mug, flip it, set it down, and then attach it to the dark gray rack.
Take the beige mug with one arm, rotate it, and hang it onto the dark gray rack.
Take the medium beige mug from the table, spin it, place it in the center, then hang it on the metallic angular rack with rod pair.
Use the left arm to grab the mug with glossy texture, rotate it, place it down, and hang it onto the angular rack with slanted support rod with the right arm.
